lane_values_nonnegative.name: lane_values_nonnegative
lane_values_nonnegative.value: "lanes"."trusted_energy_wh" >= 0 and "lanes"."trusted_delivered_value" >= 0 and "lanes"."authorized_value" >= 0 and "lanes"."settled_value" >= 0 and ("lanes"."confirmed_deposit" is null or "lanes"."confirmed_deposit" >= 0) and ("lanes"."funded_headroom" is null or "lanes"."funded_headroom" >= 0) and "lanes"."unverified_service_bound" >= 0 and "lanes"."worst_case_delivered_value" >= 0 and "lanes"."protected_value" >= 0 and "lanes"."protected_watermark" >= 0 and "lanes"."unprotected_exposure_bound" >= 0

lane_value_order.name: lane_value_order
lane_value_order.value: "lanes"."authorized_value" <= "lanes"."trusted_delivered_value" and "lanes"."settled_value" <= "lanes"."authorized_value" and ("lanes"."confirmed_deposit" is null or "lanes"."authorized_value" <= "lanes"."confirmed_deposit") and "lanes"."protected_value" <= "lanes"."authorized_value" and "lanes"."protected_value" <= "lanes"."trusted_delivered_value"

evidence_values_nonnegative.name: evidence_values_nonnegative
evidence_values_nonnegative.value: ("meter_evidence"."cumulative_wh" is null or "meter_evidence"."cumulative_wh" >= 0) and ("meter_evidence"."cumulative_milli_wh" is null or "meter_evidence"."cumulative_milli_wh" >= 0)

verified_voucher_has_proof.name: verified_voucher_has_proof
verified_voucher_has_proof.value: "tempo_vouchers"."verification_status" <> 'verified' or ("tempo_vouchers"."digest" is not null and "tempo_vouchers"."signature" is not null and "tempo_vouchers"."verified_at" is not null)
